social_text_1: At E3i we apply engineering with a clear purpose: to improve people's lives and protect the environment.
social_text_2: From energy and industry to security and the environment, we develop solutions that drive efficiency, sustainability and collective well-being.
history_text_1: Since its establishment in 2004, E3i-procdos Sociedad Limitada has based its operations on integrity, commitment to technical excellence, and the development of human talent within the company, in an environment of respect, collaboration, and professional freedom. This way of acting is reflected in all its projects: engineering, architecture, installations, and energy efficiency, for building, industry, and tertiary sectors.
history_text_2: The first written guidelines on internal style and values were developed when the company evolved from its original name ("PROCDOS SL") to the new identity "E3i-Procdos SL". At that time, commitments were defined towards clients, suppliers, collaborators, and entities with which it maintains ties, including a zero-tolerance policy against any improper or illegal conduct, and the requirement for exemplary professional behavior.
history_text_3: With its activity focused on the provision of energy services, energy efficiency in commercial, industrial, and residential installations, as well as the promotion and construction of homes, buildings, and industrial warehouses, E3i has incorporated these values into its daily business operations.

idi_text_1: At E3i we conceive innovation as the engine that drives our activity from engineering towards the generation of real, efficient and sustainable solutions. We do not understand R&D&I as an isolated department, but as a way of working that runs through every project, every technical analysis and every strategic decision. Our mission is not only to apply what already exists, but to develop what is not yet available for our clients, anticipating new energy, technological and market needs.
idi_text_2: We live in a business and social context where the energy transition, advanced digitalization and decarbonization are no longer future trends, but present priorities. Therefore, at E3i we are committed to applied innovation, with a direct impact on energy efficiency, facility optimization and the creation of our own products and methodologies that provide added value and differentiate our clients in terms of competitiveness, sustainability and technical safety.
idi_point_1: Solid technical experience, the result of years of work in engineering and installations.
idi_point_2: Advanced analysis and design capability, supported by data, simulation and digital technology.
idi_point_3: Strategic vision of the energy and industry sector, which allows us to anticipate regulations, management models and future needs.
idi_point_4: Internal culture oriented to continuous improvement, where each project is also a laboratory of learning and evolution.
vision_text: At E3i we understand innovation as a continuous process, which goes beyond incorporating technology: it consists of transforming the way energy is designed, managed and optimized in buildings, industry and cities.

compliance_quality_text: Our innovative activity is developed under a solid framework of regulatory compliance, technical responsibility and ethical culture, aligned with our quality and sustainability policies.
area_industry_text: It encompasses engineering and adaptation of industrial, agro-food, mining and chemical storage facilities. It also includes the design and legalization of service stations, public venues and industrial warehouses, as well as fire protection studies and metallic structure calculations.
area_oilgas_text: It encompasses the development, legalization and technical control of installations related to liquid and gaseous fuels, both in industrial and supply environments. It includes storage, distribution, service station and associated security systems projects, ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.
area_building_text: It integrates engineering and technical consulting services for all types of buildings, from new construction to renovations and rehabilitation. It covers installation design, energy efficiency, regulatory adaptation and comprehensive project management, providing complete solutions for residential, tertiary and industrial architecture.
area_energy_text: It focuses on the design, engineering and legalization of low and high voltage electrical installations, both in buildings and industrial environments. It also integrates power line and transformation center projects, photovoltaic systems and special communication, voice, data and public address solutions.
area_renewables_text: It specializes in the design, implementation and legalization of clean energy systems such as photovoltaic solar, solar thermal, biomass or aerothermal. Its activity is oriented towards energy transition, emission reduction and consumption optimization, both in industrial, residential and service projects.
area_security_text: It offers services oriented to occupational risk prevention and the implementation of protection measures for workers, facilities and productive environments. In addition, it develops environmental control and management actions, guaranteeing compliance with current regulations and project sustainability.
savings_subtitle: Efficiency that transforms into real results
savings_text_1: At E3i we understand energy savings not as an isolated objective, but as a comprehensive strategy for technical, economic and environmental improvement. Our work focuses on analyzing, optimizing and redesigning facilities and processes to reduce consumption, minimize operating costs and improve the overall performance of energy systems in buildings, industries and urban spaces.
savings_text_2: We apply advanced engineering, digitalization and intelligent control methodologies so that our clients consume less, produce better and operate with greater reliability, aligning with new sustainability and competitiveness standards.
